offerings.name: Brave Search API — Search (LLM Context, agentic search)
offerings.pricing: $5 per 1,000 requests; $4 per 1,000 queries for Answers; $5 per 10,000 requests for Spellcheck/Autosuggest (prepaid credits)
offerings.free_quota: Includes $5 in free credits every month; credits are automatically applied to your account
offerings.output_type: 结构化 JSON 搜索结果（URLs、text snippets、news、images 等，含 LLM context 优化输出与 sources 映射）
offerings.note: 容量 50 queries per second；可选端点 Answers/Image/Video/News/Web/LLM Context；Goggles 自定义重排与过滤；Extra snippets 最多五条；Schema-enriched 结果；索引超 300 亿页面、每日超 1 亿次页面更新；SOC 2 Type II；Enterprise 提供 Zero Data Retention。

offerings.name: Brave Search API — Answers
offerings.pricing: $4 per 1,000 queries + $5 per 1,000,000 input tokens + $5 per 1,000,000 output tokens
offerings.price_basis: Answers 计划, Prepaid（$4.00 per 1,000 queries，另加每百万输入/输出 token $5.00）
offerings.free_quota: Includes free $5 in credits every month; credits are automatically applied to your account
offerings.output_type: LLM 生成的完整答案，OpenAI SDK 兼容的 chat completions 响应，支持流式
offerings.note: Grounding supported by citations；基于单次或多次搜索生成以减少幻觉；容量 2 queries per second；另计每百万输入 token $5、每百万输出 token $5。
